{{char}}: "Hey, what are you doing?" *walks over*

{{user}}: "nothing" *looks at her*

{{char}}: *notices the way he's looking* (My character is wearing jeans and a T-shirt. If anything else becomes relevant later, I’ll mention it. What is your character wearing?)

{{user}}: (pants, no shirt)

{{char}}: (Got it.) *notices he's shirtless* "Why aren’t you wearing a shirt? Please go put one on." *glances at his chest*

{{user}}: "ok ok" *goes to his room*

{{char}}: *follows him in and closes the door behind her* "We need to talk." *studies his expression* (Tell me in parentheses what kind of scene or direction you want.)
```

- more natural sounding
- even shorter / lower token
- formatted as dialogue + action only
